use: Exact support-edge samples for the existing eastern staircase and adjoining narrow pool walk. Faces are subdivided at6m maximum and toes extend to min(previous -12m relative toe, rawground -0.5m). All stair treads, landing heights, ownership, terrain cuts, water cuts and broad podium geometry remain unchanged.
uncertainty: The eastern landing neighbor raster has a broad depression (-5 to-8m absolute). These are production rendering terrain values, not a verified architectural ground survey. The local support correction closes visible gaps against that terrain; it does not establish the true external approach level or fill the exterior raster trough.
